issues.problem: The English adds a quoted essay title from the 1877 sketch — "On the Tendency of Species to form Varieties, and on the Perpetuation of Species and Varieties by means of Natural Selection" — which has no counterpart in the Chinese text; the Chinese only reports the date, the transmission through Lyell, and the reading alongside Darwin's paper.
issues.suggestion: Add the essay title quoted in the sketch to the Chinese sentence (e.g. 小传给出的标题是《论物种形成变种的倾向，以及物种与变种借自然选择得以延续》), or delete the title clause from the English.

issues.problem: Chinese says the journal requires 先定下署名方式 (how authorship is to be assigned), while English narrows this to "the order of the names".
issues.suggestion: Align one with the other, e.g. Chinese 署名顺序 (order of the names) to match the English and the later alternative field.

overall: The two editions match closely in facts, dates and attributions, with one content gap: the English carries a quoted essay title from the 1877 sketch that the Chinese omits.
